content: You will be given an argumentation and asked about to find the relation from relation types: sup (support), exa (support by example), add (additional source), reb (rebutting attack), und (undercutting attack), joint (joining relation) between two selected argument components from it.

Excessive consumption of meat is unhealthy. Furthermore, the production of meat is comparably resource-intensive. We should thus all limit our consumption of meat rigorously. One could worry that our farmers would then run into economic difficulties. However, no serious economist has confirmed this prediction to date.
What is the relation between "Excessive consumption of meat is unhealthy." and "Furthermore, the production of meat is comparably resource-intensive." from the above essay? Choose from following options 1. reb
2. und
3. joint
4. exa
5. sup
6. no relation
